post.summary: Log out — ends the session (idempotent)
post.description: Kills the Keycloak session so the refresh token dies immediately; the access token already in the browser is NOT revoked and expires on its own within the realm's short lifespan (~2 min). scope="all" ends every device session. Re-calling is safe. The frontend must clear its own tokens regardless of the response.

Inventory heatmap — how many screens still have k slots free
post.description:
For every k, the number of the client's screens with at least k slots free across the whole window: image and video curves, plus the joint grid for screens that can take both.

ADVISORY: read from CDC replicas which lag, so it carries computedAt and can never cause an over-sell — availability-search remains the booking authority.

imageMarginal and videoMarginal are NOT the grid's edges. Render the histogram from the marginals directly; summing a grid row under-reports availability.

Terminate a contract (step 1 of 2, OTP-gated)
post.description: Validates the contract is terminable (SCHEDULED/ACTIVE/PAUSED) and sends an OTP to the calling admin. Writes nothing; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CONTRACT_TERMINATE), which flips ACTIVE/PAUSED → TERMINATED (SCHEDULED → CANCELLED) and frees the contract's inventory. Optional reason.

post.summary: Extend a contract in place (step 1 of 2, OTP-gated)
post.description: Moves the contract's end date out (newEndDate required); the same contract is extended in place — no successor contract is created. commercialMode must be omitted (400 MODE_LOCKED_ON_EXTEND). Sends an OTP; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CONTRACT_EXTEND).

post.summary: Cancel a contract extension / shorten (step 1 of 2, OTP-gated)
post.description: Pulls the contract's end back before the chosen extension (periodId from GET .../rate-periods; e_0, the original term, is rejected — terminate instead), freeing that inventory and cancelling its billing segments. A future extension is removed whole (with every later one); an already-running one is cut to today. Sends an OTP; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CONTRACT_EXTENSION_CANCEL), which returns the refreshed rate periods.

post.summary: Amend a contract's rate/plan (step 1 of 2, OTP-gated)
post.description: Reprices a targeted rate period (optional periodId from GET .../rate-periods; omit → current period). At least one of ratePerDevicePreGst/imageSlotRate/videoSlotRate/subscriptionPlan is required (else 400 AMEND_EMPTY). Sends an OTP; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CLIENT_CONTRACT_AMEND).

post.summary: Initiate OTP-gated activation of an AD_PARTNER contract's inventory
post.description: OTP-gated, ADOPS-only. Until a contract is activated its slot leases stay DRAFT, the availability picker returns nothing for it and no campaign can be booked against it. Sends an OTP to the caller admin and mutates nothing; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CONTRACT_ACTIVATE). No request body. One-shot — a second attempt returns 409.

get.summary: List all clients with dashboard stats

post.summary: Create a new client and client user
post.description: Creates a new client and an associated platform user. Accessible by ADOPS_ADMIN role.

post.summary: Start suspending a client (OTP step 1 of 2)
post.description: Suspend stops the client's campaigns — existing ads drop off screens on the next manifest rebuild and no new campaign can be created or launched. Non-campaign operations (contracts, wallet, members, stores, creatives) continue and login is unaffected. Reversible via reactivate; nothing is cancelled. Sends an OTP to the caller admin; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify. Legal from ACTIVE or FROZEN.

post.summary: Start reactivating a client (OTP step 1 of 2)
post.description: Returns a FROZEN or SUSPENDED client to ACTIVE. Sends an OTP to the caller admin; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify. Cannot recover a PERMANENT_BLOCK client.

post.summary: Start permanently blocking a client (OTP step 1 of 2)
post.description: IRREVERSIBLE soft-delete. The row is preserved and blocked_on stamped, but the cascade cancels active leases, bookings and slots, deactivates allocations and frees inventory. The client's users can no longer log in — generate-otp refuses to send the OTP and returns 403 CLIENT_BLOCKED. Sends an OTP to the caller admin; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify. Legal from ACTIVE, FROZEN or SUSPENDED; PERMANENT_BLOCK is terminal.

post.summary: Get an upload URL for a client's logo
post.description: Step 1 of 3. PUT the file to uploadUrl, then save it with PUT /api/v1/clients/{clientId}/logo.

post.summary: Start freezing a client (OTP step 1 of 2)
post.description: Freeze blocks ONLY new campaign creation; existing campaigns keep playing and every non-campaign operation (contracts, wallet, members, stores, creatives, rate-cards) continues. Login is unaffected. Sends an OTP to the caller admin — NOTHING is written here. Confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CLIENT_STATUS_CHANGE) to apply it. Legal only from ACTIVE.

post.summary: Start swapping the live client admin
post.description: Sends an OTP to the caller. On verify the incumbent is retired and the target promoted in one transaction, so the client is never left without an admin.

post.summary: Start creating a client admin
post.description: Sends an OTP to the caller. Nothing is written until it is verified. The new admin is created INACTIVE — a bench contact that cannot log in until a swap promotes them.

post.summary: Start reassigning a client's account manager
post.description: Sends an OTP to the caller. On verify the outgoing manager's grant is revoked and the incoming one written in one transaction, so the client is never left without one.

Initiate OTP-gated registration of a discovered batch (Program + Premium flag)
post.description: OTP-gated. Validates the batch is DISCOVERED and the chosen program is resolvable, then sends an OTP to the caller admin. Nothing is mutated yet — confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose BATCH_REGISTER) to flip the batch DISCOVERED → CREATED. Identified by human-readable batchCode (e.g. "B001") so ad-ops can register straight off the hardware label.

post.summary: Discover a batch by pulling its snapshot from Hardware-Management-Service
post.description: Adops admin enters a batchCode; BFF proxies to open-service which calls HMS by code and persists batch + devices + mappings into campaign-service in DISCOVERED state. Follow up with `register` to bind a program and the premium label.

get.summary: Accrual revenue breakdown for an AD_PARTNER over an optional [from,to] window (omit = all-time)
Revenue generated by one campaign manager: monthly chart + brand-wise rollup
get.description: Brands are the AP's children assigned to this manager. Revenue is recognised in FULL in each campaign's start month (not pro-rated) and counts SCHEDULED, LIVE, COMPLETED and CANCELLED — cancelled included because no refund is issued. These figures therefore do NOT reconcile with the AP revenue breakdown above. revenueTrendPct is null when the previous month had no revenue (trendDirection=NEW).

get.summary: Campaign activity for one manager: campaigns across all their brands + tab counts
get.description: statusCounts always carries every CampaignStatus plus ALL, computed across ALL the manager's campaigns — NOT the filtered page — so selecting a tab does not zero the others. screens is TRI-STATE: absent = the campaign has no device-selection rows at all (a DRAFT before devices are picked, or one whose selections a slot change invalidated), 0 = rows exist summing to zero. progressPct is absent for DRAFT and CANCELLED — render no progress bar for those.

get.description: Original + amend + extension periods with effective dates and per-period rates. editable=false marks a fully-elapsed period. A period's id feeds an amend request as its target period.

get.summary: Placement summary for a contract — where its batch's devices physically sit
get.description: City → retail host store (premium) or shop category (non-premium); `groupBy` says which. Unplaced devices are reported separately rather than dropped. `activated` is derived from the contract's slot-lease status. Powers the Activate Contract modal.

List devices for the operating brand (V2 master sheet RP #27).
Per-device campaign detail scoped to the client's own campaigns + their LIVE-campaign count.
get.description: Only campaigns OWNED by the client (campaign.clientId) on this device. Returns activeCampaignCount (the client's LIVE campaigns on the device) and drops clientName.

get.summary: Client device roster from the analytics read model — online/offline + deviceVariant.
get.description: Mongo-backed sibling of RP #27. isOnline is TRI-STATE: absent = never seen, which is not the same as offline. No lastSeenAt. Freshness is CDC-driven, so a stalled telemetry pipeline shows a stale online flag; RP #27 recomputes presence on every read instead.

get.summary: Client device-info list — location, presence, host brand and the client's live campaigns per screen.
get.description: Scoped by SLOT ownership (the client bought slots on the device), NOT store ownership like the roster above — the two legitimately report different device counts for the same client. storeCategory is present only on non-premium rows and brandHost only on premium ones. isOnline is TRI-STATE: absent = never seen, which is not the same as offline (status=OFFLINE does return those devices). The `locality` param searches locality ONLY, not device code.

get.summary: Brand-admin dashboard composite (V2 RP sheet #4.0). Same payload as GET /clients/{clientId}.
CPM calculation — image/video device counts for a client×city×shopType×tier slice + window math.
get.description: Counts the client's SLOT-owned devices carrying an image slot (hero_pct>0) vs a video slot (showcase_pct>0); a device with both is counted in both. cityCode, shopType and isPremium are required; loopTime (seconds, default 60) drives cyclesInWindow. Window is the fixed Q2 12h/4-slot day.

get.summary: List a client's contracts grouped by batch
get.description: Paginated over batch groups, not contracts: page (0-based), size (1-200, default 20); totalElements counts batches. Optional filters, each picking contracts (a batch shows if at least one matches): repeatable contractStatus and subscriptionPlan, activeFrom / activeTo (yyyy-MM-dd). sortBy: createdOn (newest contract, default) | startDate (earliest start) | endDate (latest end); sortOrder: ASC | DESC (default DESC). Each row carries the extended / extensionCount / lastExtendedAt flags.

get.description: Same shape as get-by-id, including the extended / extensionCount / lastExtendedAt flags.

UpdateRateSurchargeRequest.description: Request payload for updating a rate surcharge

clientId.description: Client ID — present when scope is SCOPE_CLIENT

UpdateContractRequest.description: Partial-update payload. State-aware: DRAFT full surface, ACTIVE narrow editable surface, RESERVED rejected. Null fields ignored.

modelType.description: Allocation commercial model (DRAFT only — full-replace allocation block)

deviceRentalRate.description: Monthly device rental rate in INR (RENTAL_MODEL only)

imageCpm.description: CPM per thousand impressions, image creatives. REVENUE_SHARING only; both or neither.

videoCpm.description: CPM per thousand impressions, video creatives.

sections.description: Full-replace section list (DRAFT only). When provided, modelType is also required.

ClientAssignmentSection.description: Per-section ownership a single client holds on a batch

totalExpectedItems.description: Total items the contract is entitled to deploy on the batch — equals batch.deviceCount when contract.clientId == batch.primaryOwnerClientId, else 0. FE renders 'X / Y locked' progress.

UpdateClientAdminRequest.description: Admin edit-client payload. Only registeredName, displayName and logoUrl are editable; any other field is rejected with 400.

registeredName.description: Registered name — changing this recomputes the uniqueIdentifier slug and is checked for collisions (409 on clash)

logoUrl.description: Omit (null) to leave the logo unchanged; send an empty string to clear it. A URL is no longer accepted — upload the logo and save it with PUT /api/v1/clients/{clientId}/logo, where it is reviewed before going live.

clientId.description: Unique client identifier

logoReview.description: The latest logo submitted that is not live yet (waiting, flagged or rejected). Single-client reads only; null otherwise.

clientType.description: Client type — source of truth post client-model refactor

blockedOn.description: Timestamp when client was permanently blocked (null if not blocked)

parentId.description: Parent client id (set for BRAND_UNDER_AD_PARTNER and grouped NETWORK_PARTNER; null otherwise)

brandColors.description: JSON string {"primary": "#hex", "secondary": "#hex"} — brand colours for FE branding.

assignedUserId.description: User that received the initial access grant. Populated on create only.

MediaReviewInfoResponse.description: A submitted logo or photo that is not live yet, and why.

reviewId.description: Review id — the id the manual approve / reject endpoint takes

reasonCode.description: Why it went to review: the AI's reason, NO_VERDICT after a timeout, or CONFIG_MISMATCH

message.description: The AI's sentence for the user
message.example: This photo is blurry. Hold your phone steady and take it again.

decisionReason.example: Logo does not match the registered brand

mediaUrl.description: The submitted image, not live yet

UpdateClientRateCardRequest.description: Request payload for updating a client rate card

imageSlotRate.description: Updated PER-MONTH rate for one image slot on one device, for THIS daypart. Passed through untouched — open-service converts it to the per-play rate that is actually stored.

videoSlotRate.description: Updated PER-MONTH rate for one video slot on one device, for THIS daypart. Passed through untouched — open-service converts it to the per-play rate that is actually stored.

imageCpm.description: CPM for one image slot. TARGETED only — send INSTEAD of imageSlotRate.

videoCpm.description: CPM for one video slot. TARGETED only.

clientId.description: Client ID (brand)

imageSlotRate.description: Image slot rate PER SLOT PER MONTH for this daypart — the same unit the create/update request carries, so what was sent is what comes back

videoSlotRate.description: Video slot rate PER SLOT PER MONTH for this daypart — the same unit the create/update request carries, so what was sent is what comes back

imageCpm.description: CPM for one image slot. TARGETED only — send INSTEAD of imageSlotRate.

videoCpm.description: CPM for one video slot. TARGETED only.

rateCardType.description: Which delivery mode this row prices

ageGroups.description: Empty or omitted = every age band

UpdateCampaignRequest.description: Update campaign request — all fields optional, only non-null fields are updated

clientId.description: Operating client ID

advertisedBrandId.description: Advertised brand ID (the brand whose ads play)

daysOfWeek.description: Days the campaign plays on. Omit / send empty to leave the existing value unchanged.

deviceTier.description: Inventory tier to switch the DRAFT campaign to — PREMIUM / NON_PREMIUM. Omit to leave the tier unchanged. A real switch clears the existing screen selections and creatives, and is rejected while a booking reservation is active.

targets.description: TARGETED publish scopes; replaces them wholesale. Omit = untouched.

targeting.description: TARGETED criteria, bids, budget and pacing. Omit = untouched; a partial block merges field by field.

deliveryMode.description: Which mode this campaign is in. Sending the mode it already has asserts it and changes nothing; sending the other one switches a DRAFT over, deactivating the previous mode's scope and creatives and returning it to SELECTIONS_SAVED so the scope can be rebuilt on the following screens. Mandatory: an optional mode that defaulted to BROADCAST would turn every edit that forgot it into a silent conversion.

UpdateBrandRequest.description: Partial update of a brand. Omitted fields are left unchanged. brandLogoUrl / brandDescription / website / designation accept an empty string to clear the stored value.

brandName.description: Brand display name. Can be changed but not cleared.

brandLogoUrl.description: Send "" to remove the logo. A URL is no longer accepted — upload the logo and save it with PUT /api/v1/clients/{clientId}/logo, where it is reviewed before going live.

designation.description: Contact person designation. Send "" to clear.

industry.description: Business category. Can be changed but not cleared.

subIndustry.description: Business sub-category. Can be changed but not cleared.

agencyId.description: Agency this brand belongs to. null for standalone brands.

campaignsCount.description: Number of campaigns associated with this brand

totalBudget.description: Total budget allocated to this brand

UpdateBatchRateCardRequest.description: Request payload for updating a batch rate card

imageSlotRate.description: Updated image slot rate per device per day

videoSlotRate.description: Updated video slot rate per device per day

clientId.description: Client ID — null for base/default rate

imageSlotRate.description: Image slot rate per device per day

videoSlotRate.description: Video slot rate per device per day

contractId.description: Contract this rate belongs to — null for a standing/base rate

validFrom.description: Effective-from instant of this rate period (null for a standing rate)

deviceRentalRate.description: Per-device rental rate (RENTAL_MODEL); null for REVENUE_SHARING

supersededAt.description: Superseded-at instant — non-null once a newer period replaced this one

changeReason.description: Why this period was written (CONTRACT_START / AMEND / EXTEND)

sourceRef.description: OTP reference that authorised this rate period

extensionSeq.description: Extension ordinal this period belongs to (0 = original term)

cancelledAt.description: Non-null = this rate period was cancelled by a cancel-extension or terminate.

CreateConsignmentRequest.description: Request payload for creating a new consignment

vendorContact.description: Vendor contact details (free text — name, email, phone)

orderPlacedDate.description: Order placed date in ISO format

qcFileId.description: UUID of the uploaded_file row returned by /v1/hm/consignment/upload-url after the QC file is uploaded to S3. Optional when qcBypassed=true.

qcBypassed.description: HM's call at creation: no QC verification for this consignment — devices go straight to install. Makes qcFileId optional.

deviceCount.description: Number of devices parsed from the QC report by frontend (server validates against re-parse)

notes.example: First Lenovo shipment for the year. QC pass-rate 98.4%.

uploadedBy.description: ID of Hardware Manager who uploaded

uploadedByName.description: Name of Hardware Manager who uploaded

qcFileId.description: FK to uploaded_file in cloud-storage-service. Use GET /api/v1/storage/files/{fileId} to fetch metadata. Null when qcBypassed.

qcBypassed.description: True when HM waived QC for this consignment at creation

deviceCount.description: Number of devices in this consignment

verifiedDeviceCount.description: Number of devices verified at install station

GetConsignmentUploadUrlRequest.description: Request payload for generating a pre-signed S3 upload URL for QC report

GetConsignmentUploadUrlResponse.description: Pre-signed S3 upload URL for direct file upload

fileId.description: UUID of the uploaded_file ledger row in cloud-storage-service. Frontend stores this and passes it back when creating the consignment.

uploadUrl.description: Pre-signed S3 PUT URL valid until expiresAt

maxSizeBytes.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes

CreateWorkerRequest.description: Hardware-Manager request to create a worker (Kelly or Station)

refreshToken.description: The user's refresh token — the logout credential (works even after the access token has expired).

scope.description: "all" ends every device session; omit (or any other value) ends only this session.

sessionEnded.description: True if Keycloak accepted the end-session (the refresh token is now dead).

CreateRateSurchargeRequest.description: Request payload for creating a rate surcharge

clientId.description: Client ID — required when scope is SCOPE_CLIENT

StorageUploadUrlRequest.description: Request for a presigned S3 upload URL. The FE PUTs the bytes to the returned uploadUrl, then calls /api/v1/storage/upload-confirm with the returned fileId.

module.description: Storage module, which fixes the folder, allowed content types and size cap

pathSegments.description: Optional sub-folder segments under the module

contentType.description: MIME content type, validated against the module's allowed list

fileSize.description: File size in bytes, validated against the module's cap

InventoryHeatmapRequest.description: Inventory heatmap request. Answers 'how many of my screens still have at least k slots free' across a date window, for every k, for image and video.

clientId.description: Operating client UUID. AD_PARTNER / NETWORK_PARTNER pass their own id; ADOPS_ADMIN must select one.

startDate.description: Window start, yyyy-MM-dd (IST calendar date), inclusive

endDate.description: Window end, yyyy-MM-dd (IST calendar date), inclusive. Any span — 2 days and 30 days are both supported.

cities.description: Optional. Absent list = no restriction on that dimension.

sections.description: Opt-in extras: KPIS, LOOP_TIERS. Ceiling, marginals and grid are always returned.

InventoryHeatmapResponse.description: Inventory depth histogram: for every k, how many screens still have at least k slots free across the whole window.

ceilingImage.description: Largest image slot count any in-scope screen can hold — the grid's row count

ceilingVideo.description: Largest video slot count any in-scope screen can hold — the grid's column count

videoMarginal.description: index k-1 = screens with at least k VIDEO slots free

grid.description: grid[i-1][j-1] = screens that can take at least i image AND at least j video slots ON THE SAME SCREEN, every selected day and slot. Empty when either ceiling is zero.

kpis.description: Section KPIS; null when not requested

loopTiers.description: Section LOOP_TIERS; null when not requested

windowMode.description: Echoed back. ANY_DAY results are NOT bookable across the window — disable or warn on any 'start a campaign with this' action.
